title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Beloit College
description: Late-night dining options for Beloit College students, ranging from on-campus study breaks to local 24-hour convenience runs and late-night delivery favorites.

cards.title: Late-Night Study Breaks at Hamiltons
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Dining at the Powerhouse
cards.notes: Visit the Powerhouse for scheduled late-night study breaks featuring breakfast foods like pancakes, often served by college faculty and staff during finals week.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall located in the Powerhouse student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamiltons in the Powerhouse hosts late-night study breaks with breakfast food served at 9:00 PM during exam periods.
cards.source_title: Bon Appétit at Beloit College | Beloit WI - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Open for special late-night events until 11:00 PM or later; regular dinner ends at 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Grab-and-Go at DK's
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall Cafe
cards.notes: Stop by Pearsons Hall for late-evening snacks and smoothies. It serves as a convenient academic-side alternative to the main dining hall.
cards.short_summary: A casual cafe in Pearsons Hall offering grab-and-go food and smoothies.
cards.evidence_claim: DK's in Pearsons Hall is open until 8:00 PM Monday through Friday for general service.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Community • Residential Life - Beloit College

cards.title: The 4 AM Riverside Run
cards.subtitle: 1841 Riverside Dr
cards.notes: Drive down Riverside Drive for late-night tacos and burritos. The drive-thru remains open until 4:00 AM daily for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night fast food destination located south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1841 Riverside Dr has drive-thru hours until 4:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Beloit, WI - 1841 Riverside Dr.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4:00 AM; dining room closes at midnight.

cards.title: Late-Night Bites on State Street
cards.subtitle: 45 State St
cards.notes: Walk or drive to this nearby location for classic burgers and fries. It is one of the closest late-night options to the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food staple located just blocks from the Beloit College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 45 State St is open until 11:00 PM daily, with extended hours until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Beloit, WI at 45 State St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sun-Thu and 12:00 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Late-Night Topperstix Delivery
cards.subtitle: Delivery to Campus
cards.notes: Order Topperstix or specialty pizzas for delivery directly to your dorm. They are a staple for late-night study sessions and weekend gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A regional pizza chain known for late-night delivery and signature cheesy bread.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza offers delivery in Beloit with late-night hours, typically until 2:00 AM or later on weekends.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Delivery in Beloit, WI | Grubhub
cards.access_notes: Delivery available until 2:00 AM or later depending on the day.

cards.title: 24-Hour Breakfast at Perkins
cards.subtitle: 2787 Milwaukee Rd
cards.notes: Head to Milwaukee Road for a full sit-down breakfast at any hour. It is a classic destination for students looking for a late-night meal off-campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour American diner and bakery located a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins Restaurant & Bakery on Milwaukee Road in Beloit is open 24 hours on weekends.
cards.source_title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery in Beloit, WI
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours on Saturdays and Sundays; open until midnight on weekdays.

cards.title: The 24/7 Kwik Trip Run
cards.subtitle: 3155 Prairie Ave
cards.notes: Visit Kwik Trip for 24-hour access to hot food, snacks, and Glazers donuts. It is a reliable stop for students with cars at any time of night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station offering a variety of fresh food.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip #1151 at 3155 Prairie Ave is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Late-Night Pizza at Casey's
cards.subtitle: 1871 E Inman Pkwy
cards.notes: Pick up a famous Casey's pizza or grab snacks until 10:00 PM. While not 24 hours, it remains a popular evening stop for students in the area.
cards.short_summary: A convenience store known for its made-to-order pizza and evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 1871 E Inman Pkwy is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Beloit, WI | Casey's

cards.title: Evening Essentials at Walgreens
cards.subtitle: 910 Broad St
cards.notes: Walk to Broad Street for late-evening snacks, drinks, or pharmacy needs. It is a convenient downtown stop for students living near the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and retail store located in downtown Beloit near the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walgreens at 910 Broad St is open until 8:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: 910 BROAD ST, Beloit, WI 53511 - Walgreens Pharmacy

cards.title: 24/7 Access at The Pantry
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Food Resource
cards.notes: Access free food and hygiene items at any time. This student-led resource ensures that no student goes hungry, regardless of the hour.
cards.short_summary: A free, 24/7 food and essentials resource for Beloit College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pantry is a free service open to all Beloit College students, providing 24/7 access to donated food and hygiene items.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Community • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for all Beloit College students.
